low_flight.clearance_source: User decision 2026-10-05: camera as low as possible relative to the lowest point of the assembled copter in flight; hard forbidden halfspace at max(lowest hardware bottom, camera bottom - guard_drop_mm), so the frame protrudes at most guard_drop_mm below the camera; no lens objective term, mass-only objective; lowest field material (rho > 0.5) reported as monitor camera_lens_clearance
low_flight.guard_source: Interim ground protection until the crash-reserve evaluator: beside the camera (|x| from half width + 0.5 to + 6 mm, |y - y_camera| <= half length + 3 mm) allowed cells whose lowest corner in flight attitude lies at or below the camera bottom, i.e. the lowest admissible layer between camera bottom - guard_drop_mm and camera bottom; projected area >= guard_area_mm2
low_flight.acceptance_source: Reconstructed frame: lens to whole-assembly bottom <= maximum_gap_mm + acceptance_tolerance_mm and frame beside the camera reaching the camera bottom within acceptance_tolerance_mm (surface smoothing of the voxel result)
low_flight.pose_source: ground15 runs (docs/validation/dgx/ground15_*.json): camera tilt 15 deg at 15 deg nose-down flight attitude, optical axis level (user decision 2026-10-05); camera y 52 mm and bottom_clearance -4 mm set with the ground15 integration (a647e6c) without recorded derivation, camera envelope bottom z = base plate 2.5 - 4 = -1.5 mm above the design floor z = -4 mm
low_flight.lens_source: Front-face midpoint of the selected camera envelope; physical optical-centre offset remains unmeasured

info.measure: lens height above the lowest of hardware and field cells with rho > 0.5 (lowest voxel corner) in flight attitude; monitor only
